Cookie & storage controls

Updated October 7, 2026.

Necessary storage

Office and Crew use browser storage for signed-in sessions and offline job work. The website may remember a dismissed audience banner and your privacy preference. These functions support the experience you requested. Signing out and clearing browser data affect stored sessions and unsynced work.

Optional measurement

Choose whether this browser may send basic website funnel events. These events should not include contact details or calculator amounts. Optional measurement starts off until you select it. Your choice does not stop necessary security logs or erase already-collected records.

Marketing preferences

Measurement and marketing email are different choices. Use the contact form to opt out of marketing. Account and service notices may continue where permitted.

Future tracking tools

Advertising pixels and new analytics must not load ahead of applicable consent. Review the notice and privacy-signal handling before adding them. A preference switch alone does not control a third-party script that ignores it.
